_about: CANDIDATE holidays only. Importing this file does NOT make any day a holiday.
An admin must observe each one per location before it affects attendance.
needs_verification = false  — the date is fixed by the Gregorian calendar, or
is solar-reckoned and effectively fixed (Pongal / Makar Sankranti sit on
14 January and drift by about a day per century). Safe to observe as-is.
needs_verification = true   — the festival follows a lunar calendar (Diwali,
Holi, the two Eids, Dussehra, Onam ...). The date here is a PLACEHOLDER and
may be wrong. The API refuses to observe these until an admin supplies the
correct date, because a wrong holiday date rewrites attendance for every
state_code is an ISO 3166-2:IN suffix matched against locations.state_code.

holidays.name: New Year's Day
holidays.notes: Fixed date. Not a central gazetted holiday but observed as a corporate holiday by most companies.

holidays.name: Pongal (Thai Pongal)
holidays.notes: Solar calendar — 14 January. Tamil Nadu's principal harvest festival; most Chennai employers close 14-16 January.

holidays.name: Makar Sankranti
holidays.notes: Solar calendar — 14 January. The same day as Pongal.

holidays.name: Thiruvalluvar Day
holidays.notes: Tamil Nadu government holiday, day after Pongal.

holidays.name: Uzhavar Thirunal (Farmers' Day)
holidays.notes: Tamil Nadu government holiday, third day of the Pongal cluster.

holidays.name: Republic Day
holidays.notes: Gazetted. Fixed date.

holidays.name: Tamil New Year (Puthandu)
holidays.notes: Solar calendar — 14 April. Tamil Nadu government holiday.

holidays.name: Dr. Ambedkar Jayanti
holidays.notes: Fixed date. Public holiday in most states, including Tamil Nadu.

holidays.name: May Day / Labour Day
holidays.notes: Fixed date. A state holiday in Tamil Nadu, Kerala, Karnataka, Maharashtra, West Bengal and others.

holidays.name: Independence Day
holidays.notes: Gazetted. Fixed date.

holidays.name: Gandhi Jayanti
holidays.notes: Gazetted. Fixed date.

holidays.name: Christmas Day
holidays.notes: Gazetted. Fixed date.

holidays.name: Holi
holidays.notes: VERIFY — lunar calendar. Not a Tamil Nadu government holiday.

holidays.name: Id-ul-Fitr (Ramzan Id)
holidays.notes: VERIFY — depends on moon sighting and can shift by a day at short notice.

holidays.name: Good Friday
holidays.notes: VERIFY — moves with Easter. A Tamil Nadu government holiday.

holidays.name: Bakrid (Id-ul-Zuha)
holidays.notes: VERIFY — depends on moon sighting.

holidays.name: Muharram
holidays.notes: VERIFY — Islamic calendar.

holidays.name: Janmashtami
holidays.notes: VERIFY — lunar calendar.

holidays.name: Ganesh Chaturthi (Vinayaka Chaturthi)
holidays.notes: VERIFY — lunar calendar. Observed in Tamil Nadu, Maharashtra, Karnataka and Goa.

holidays.name: Onam
holidays.notes: VERIFY — Malayalam calendar. Kerala employers often close several days.

holidays.name: Ayudha Puja
holidays.notes: VERIFY — lunar calendar. Tamil Nadu government holiday, day before Vijaya Dashami.

holidays.name: Vijaya Dashami (Dussehra)
holidays.notes: VERIFY — lunar calendar.

holidays.name: Deepavali (Diwali)
holidays.notes: VERIFY — lunar calendar. Many employers close two or more days.

holidays.name: Guru Nanak Jayanti
holidays.notes: VERIFY — lunar calendar. Not a Tamil Nadu government holiday.
